JChatt Terms of Service & Sovereign Agreement

Document: JCHATT-TOS-2026-v2 Effective Date: 2026 Jurisdiction: International Open Source & Intermediary Law
Core Summary: By accessing or using JChatt (web, Android APK, or source code), you agree to be bound by these Terms. JChatt is a non-custodial, end-to-end encrypted protocol. You are the sole custodian of your cryptographic private keys and 12-word seed phrase. The developers, maintainers, and operators exercise zero editorial control over user transmissions and are protected under statutory Intermediary Safe Harbor provisions.

1. Acceptance of Terms & Sovereign Custody

By installing, downloading, browsing, or executing JChatt, you enter into a legally binding agreement. JChatt provides a cryptographic messaging protocol. Unlike traditional corporate communications apps, JChatt does not own, hold, or maintain access to your account credentials.

2. Eligibility & Age Requirements (Children's Protection)

You must be at least 18 years of age (or the age of majority in your jurisdiction) to use JChatt. If you are between the ages of 13 and 18, you may only use JChatt under the direct supervision and consent of a parent or legal guardian. JChatt does not knowingly solicit or collect data from minors, adhering strictly to Section 9 of the DPDPA 2023 and COPPA.

3. User Responsibility & Cryptographic Keys

Your cryptographic identity is generated entirely client-side on your device via a 12-word BIP39 mnemonic seed phrase.

  • Non-Recoverable Keys: JChatt has no "password reset" or "account recovery" feature. If you lose your 12-word recovery phrase, access to your identity and messages is permanently unrecoverable.
  • Zero Developer Access: JChatt developers cannot decrypt your messages, unlock your app, or restore your account under any circumstances.
  • Local Storage Security: You are solely responsible for safeguarding your device, screen locks, PIN codes, and recovery phrases against physical theft or malware.

4. Acceptable Use & Strict Prohibition of Unlawful Conduct

You agree that you will NOT use JChatt for any purpose prohibited by applicable local, national, or international law. Prohibited conduct includes, without limitation:

  • Distributing, producing, or facilitating Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) or non-consensual sexual content.
  • Facilitating violent terrorism, criminal extortion, or violent offenses.
  • Conducting distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks, automated malware distribution, or relay abuse.
  • Impersonating official entities or infringing on third-party intellectual property rights.

5. Statutory Intermediary Safe Harbor (Section 79, IT Act 2000 & CDA § 230)

JChatt functions solely as an "Intermediary" under Section 2(1)(w) of the Indian Information Technology Act, 2000 and an "Interactive Computer Service" provider under 47 U.S.C. § 230(c)(1) of the United States Communications Decency Act. JChatt does not initiate transmissions, select recipients, or modify transmitted content. Full statutory compliance details and Grievance Officer contacts are published at our Compliance Center.

6. Absolute Disclaimer of Warranties ("AS IS")

JCHATT AND ALL ASSOCIATED SOURCE CODE, PROTOCOLS, BINARIES, AND INTERFACES ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" AND "AS AVAILABLE", WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE, TITLE, AVAILABILITY, SECURITY, OR NON-INFRINGEMENT.

WHILE OUR PROTOCOLS UTILIZE PEER-REVIEWED CRYPTOGRAPHY (AES-256-GCM, PBKDF2, WEBRTC DTLS-SRTP), WE DO NOT WARRANT THAT THE SERVICE WILL BE UNINTERRUPTED, ACCURATE, COMPLETE, BUG-FREE, OR COMPATIBLE WITH EVERY HOST OPERATING SYSTEM OR NETWORK TOPOLOGY.

7. Total Limitation of Liability

TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY APPLICABLE LAW, IN NO EVENT SHALL JCHATT, ITS FOUNDERS, DEVELOPERS, MAINTAINERS, AFFILIATES, OR RELAY HOSTS BE LIABLE FOR ANY DIRECT, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, EXEMPLARY, OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES (INCLUDING LOSS OF PROFITS, DATA, USE, GOODWILL, OR INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY) ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO:

  • YOUR LOSS OR FORGETFULNESS OF YOUR 12-WORD SEED PHRASE, MASTER PIN, OR DURESS PIN;
  • PHYSICAL SEIZURE, FORENSIC ANALYSIS, OR COMPROMISE OF YOUR DEVICE BY ADVERSARIES;
  • THIRD-PARTY ACTIONS, MALICIOUS CIPHERTEXT INJECTION, OR TELECOM NETWORK DISRUPTIONS;

You agree to defend, indemnify, and hold harmless JChatt, its maintainers, developers, contributors, and hosting infrastructure providers from and against any claims, liabilities, damages, losses, fines, penalties, costs, and expenses (including reasonable legal fees) arising out of or related to: (a) your access to or use of JChatt; (b) any communication or material transmitted by you; (c) your violation of these Terms or any applicable statutory regulation; or (d) any infringement of third-party rights by your account handle or messages.

9. Mandatory Binding Arbitration & Class Action Waiver

WAIVER OF CLASS LAWSUITS: YOU AND JCHATT AGREE THAT ALL CLAIMS AND DISPUTES MUST BE BROUGHT IN AN INDIVIDUAL CAPACITY, AND NOT AS A PLAINTIFF OR CLASS MEMBER IN ANY PURPORTED CLASS ACTION, COLLECTIVE ACTION, PRIVATE ATTORNEY GENERAL ACTION, OR REPRESENTATIVE PROCEEDING.
